thread:
anya: Quick idea  could we compress the heatmap into a thin strip in the p95 header and move the sampling control into the scrubber? frees vertical space.
jules: sounds good in principle. worried about discoverability of sampling.
sam: +1 on compact header. maybe reveal presets on hover/focus so its discoverable but not always visible. :thinking_face:
matt: I built 3 quick mocks: inline-strip, stacked-mini, and flyout-on-focus. inline-strip keeps cards tight; stacked-mini is clearer for presets. figma: https://figma.com/s/inline-strip-mocks
anya: inline-strip is our leading candidate for dense dashboards. stacked for mobile?
leo: a11y nit: any control in the strip must have a 44px min hit area and a visible :focus-visible ring. also ensure keyboard users can tab to sampler without skipping important controls.
aria: color contrast: thin stripes make mid-tone greens fail AA. propose darker midtones + 1px stroke for selected bucket. also add a high-contrast toggle in settings.
katie: copy: label the control "Sampling rate" (not "Sample"). tooltip: "Display a subset of traces to reduce visual noise." Thoughts?
sam: prefer shorter tooltip: "Reduce noise to clarify latency patterns." show a transient numeric badge while dragging (e.g., "10%") so we dont clutter the UI.
matt: dev note: add `mini-heatmap` and `sampler-inline` components. aria-live region for SR: `aria-live=\"polite\"` announce summary on release: "Sampling set to 10 percent." Avoid announcing every small step.
leo: keyboard interactions: tab to focus, left/right = 1% nudge, shift+left/right = 10% jump, home/end = min/max, enter to open presets. SR announce on apply or >5% change.
aria: for screen readers avoid exposing each bucket as a separate tab stop. implement a single listbox-style control that cycles buckets and reads "bucket X of Y: Z traces" on request.
jules: mobile: long-press scrubber to open sampler flyout. presets should be large tappable chips.
katie: microcopy tweak: change tooltip to "Show a representative subset of traces"  slightly clearer. also preset labels: Tiny (0.5%), Low (5%), Full (100%).
sam: presets: 0.5%, 5%, 100% makes sense. also allow quick keyboard preset shortcuts (e.g., 1/2/3).
matt: handoff checklist: figma link, component tokens for focus/spacing, 44px hit area, color token updates, aria-live id `sampler-announcer`, keyboard spec, mobile long-press notes, unit tests for focus. I'll drop a dev note in the handoff doc.
anya: follow-ups: matt updates figma + handoff assets; leo/aria run keyboard & SR smoke test on prototype; katie finalizes copy; jules to test discoverability with 3 quick users.
design-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/inline-sampler-preview (expires in 48h)
anya: great  once preview is live let's run a 5-min lab. thanks team :thumbsup:
